heading: Brownfields redevelopment report

tree.heading: Definition of brownfield site
tree.text: In this section, the term “brownfield site” has the meaning given the term in section 9601(39) of this title.

children.heading: In general
children.text: Not later than 1 year after October 27, 2004, the Comptroller General shall prepare a report that evaluates the grants made by the Economic Development Administration for the economic development of brownfield sites.
identify each project conducted during the previous 10-year period in which grant funds have been used for brownfield sites redevelopment activities; and
include for each project a description of—
the type of economic development activities conducted;
the type of remediation activities; and
the amount of grant money used for those activities in dollars and as a percentage of the total grant award;
the economic development and environmental standards applied, if applicable;
the economic development impact of the project;
the role of Federal, State, or local environmental agencies, if any; and

children.heading: Submission of report
children.text: The Comptroller General shall submit to the Committee on Environment and Public Works of the Senate and the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure of the House of Representatives a copy of the report.
